about: Card 82, his pick (1) (run-answers orchestrator-B14-PREP7B-2026-11-24): on a phone whose move list is a closed sheet (320x568 against the computer), a game from a scanned board has a Best moves button after Forward in the bottom row; all seven buttons 44x44 inside the screen; a tap opens the Moves sheet with the BEST row on screen and the board unmoved; a second tap closes it. At 375x761, where the move list is not a sheet, the row is as it was. Graded by gate 235 (TC-R402..R404). NOT COVERED: the job's other parts (Review's board on his phone, the mistakes drill board, card 74's thin row - gates 228 and 26 hold those); his look on his phone.
